text.E01: For a heavily imbalanced churn classifier, would you report accuracy or PR-AUC?
text.H01: Your churn model's PR-AUC fell from 0.62 to 0.48 in production this month. Walk me through how you would find out whether it is data drift, concept drift or a pipeline bug.
text.H01F: Which of those would you rule out first, and how?
text.E02: In XGBoost, what does the learning rate scale?
text.H02: How do you choose between XGBoost and logistic regression for churn when the business needs a reason code for every customer?
text.H02F: Does your choice change at five hundred million rows?
text.E03: In top-k retrieval for RAG, what does k control?
text.E03F: And what happens to recall as k grows?
text.H03: Design the chunking and retrieval for fifty thousand PDF contracts where clauses reference other clauses.
text.H03F: What latency budget does your design assume?
text.E04: Which HTTP status should your gateway return when the downstream model times out?
text.E04F: And for a malformed client payload?
text.H04: How would you evaluate a RAG system's answers without human labels for every question?
text.H04F: Which failure would that evaluation miss?
text.E05: What does a Kubernetes readiness probe gate?
text.H05: Design a Python AI gateway that fronts three LLM providers, with failover, per-tenant rate limits and cost tracking.
text.H05F: What's the time complexity of your rate limiter?
text.E06: Is a ConfigMap the right place for an API key?
text.E06F: How are a Secret's values encoded?
text.H06: A FastAPI service's p99 latency doubles under load while CPU stays at thirty percent. What do you check, and in what order?
text.H06F: Which of those checks would you automate?
text.E07: Which S3 storage class would you use for training data you read once a year?
text.H07: How would you autoscale a GPU inference service on Kubernetes when requests arrive in bursts and a cold start takes ninety seconds?
text.H07F: Where does your approach break first?
text.E08: In Airflow, what does catchup equals false do?
text.H08: Explain the difference between requests and limits for a model-serving pod, and what happens when the pod exceeds each.
text.E09: Does a Docker container share the host's kernel?
text.H09: Design an A/B test for a new recommendation model on a retail site where purchases are rare and seasonal.
text.H09F: How long would you run it?
text.E10: Which Dockerfile instruction sets the container's default command?
text.H10: How would you detect and handle a feedback loop where the recommender keeps showing only the items it has already recommended?
text.E11: Which SageMaker feature serves many models from one endpoint?
text.E11F: Have you used that in production?
text.H11: Compare a SageMaker real-time endpoint, serverless inference and batch transform for a model called two thousand times a day with a two-second SLA.
text.E12: Which statistical test would you reach for to detect drift in a numeric feature?
text.H12: Set up monitoring for a deployed credit model: which signals, which thresholds, and who gets paged for what?
text.H12F: How would you avoid alert fatigue with that setup?
text.E13: When a CloudFormation stack is deleted, what happens to its resources by default?
text.H13: Design the S3 layout and lifecycle policy for training data that arrives daily, is reprocessed weekly and must be kept for seven years for audit.
text.E14: Which CI step should block a merge: unit tests or model retraining?
text.H14: A CloudFormation update fails halfway and rolls back, but the rollback fails too. What do you do?
text.H14F: How would you prevent that next time?
text.E15: In a token-bucket rate limiter, what does the refill rate bound?
text.H15: An Airflow DAG with two hundred tasks takes six hours, but its critical path is only two hours. How would you find and fix the bottleneck?
text.E16: What is the average time complexity of a Python dict lookup?
text.H16: Your training image is nine gigabytes and builds take forty minutes. How would you cut both without breaking reproducibility?
text.H16F: Which of your changes gives the most for the least risk?
text.E17: For nightly churn scoring of ten million customers, batch or online inference?
text.E17F: Is that still right at ten times the volume?
text.H17: Design a CI/CD pipeline for an ML model where retraining is triggered by drift, with a human approval before promotion.
text.E18: Which Kubernetes object gives pods a stable network identity: a Deployment or a StatefulSet?
text.H18: Write a function that returns the longest window of a time series in which the maximum minus the minimum stays under a threshold, and tell me its complexity.
text.H18F: Can you do it in a single pass?
text.E19: Which sampling temperature makes an LLM's output most deterministic?
text.H19: Given tables customers and payments, write the SQL for each customer's second-highest payment and the month it happened.
text.E20: Which Postgres extension stores vector embeddings?
text.E20F: How confident are you in that choice?
text.H20: Tell me about a model you shipped that hurt a business metric, and what you changed afterwards.
text.H20F: Was that the right call, in hindsight?
